description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Siemens Industry Software Inc. is hiring a Software Engineer to build core data and artificial intelligence platform services for industrial software applications. The role focuses on Data Mesh and Agentic AI services, product quality, software design, development strategy, scalability, and automation.
Software Engineer designing Data Mesh and Agentic AI services, ensuring product quality and driving performance, scalability, and automation

Responsibilities:
• Design, hands on in develop, modify, and implement modular service for Data Mesh and Agentic AI use cases
• Responsible for ensuring the overall functional quality of the released product on all required platforms and mechanism
• Creates, documents, and implements software designs which may involve complicated workflows or multiple product areas
• Collaborate regularly with other test engineers within the R&D Unit to set and drive the overall development strategy
• Set the strategy and approach of non-functional requirements like performance and scalability
• Drive automation wherever possible

Requirements:
• Ability to understand sophisticated products, data models, and communication protocol
• Strong understanding of Agentic AI and RAG, Knowledge Graph
• 1+ year of programming experience developing commercial software products using Python , Java, TypeScript, NodeJS
• Experience in full stack development implementing micro service architecture leveraging cloud native PAAS services
• Understanding of RAG, Agentic AI and Data Mesh architecture design principal
• Good knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, data modeling, algorithms
• Experience in developing software solutions using cloud native services using AWS
• Experience with AWS service like EKS, SQS, Bedrock, Agent Core, SageMaker
• Experience with Agent Framework like Strands, Langgraph, LangChain
• Hands on experience in AIML implementing vector service and RAG pipelines
• Experience in SDKs, Distributed systems, RDBMS, Microservice Architecture
• Experience in FastAPI, RESTful API's, MicroService, Containerization, Open Telemetry
• Experience with working on Gitlab, NPM, Sonar Cube, Terraform, Helm Charts
• Experience in writing Unit test, Feature Integration Tests, Automation using Postman, Newman, JMeter
• Experiecne in SQL and/or NoSQL Database concepts
• Experience in system-design and API designs
• Ability to collaborate optimally across disciplines, roles, and geographical and time zone boundaries
• Experience with Agile development, CICD, and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
• Proficiency in cross-location communication and the English language
• Flexibility to adapt to different stakeholders and environments
• Willingness to work in an open-feedback environment that wants to continue towards improvement
• Experience with challenging business partners to uncover the right requirements and clearly scope requests or ideas
• Experience with quickly learning about and familiarizing yourself with different business domains
• Experience with collaborator management between different business units and management levels
